analytical_boundary: A large gap in tick arrivals is an observation. It is not automatically missing data, market closure, bad acquisition, or a trading halt. Weekend-looking gaps remain UNRESOLVED without documented evidence.

evidence_sources.publication_or_update_date: 2022-03-21 (page metadata; MetaQuotes page does not state a separate update date)
evidence_sources.relevant_wording: MetaTrader 5 stores tick and bar open time in UTC time zone (without the shift)... The data obtained from MetaTrader 5 have UTC time.
evidence_sources.scope: Directly applies to data returned by the documented Python copy_ticks_range function. The page's return description exposes time and the Python example exposes time_msc; the wording establishes UTC for obtained tick data, but does not separately define time_msc precision semantics.

evidence_sources.classification_scope: Does not establish WM Markets trading hours or closures.
evidence_sources.relevant_fact: MT5 stores tick time in UTC and obtained data have UTC time.

privacy_statement: This bounded report contains no bid, ask, last, volume, flags, or raw Parquet payloads; the immutable raw dataset is neither modified nor copied.
provisional_timestamp_statement: UTC rendering is provisional until the historical timestamp basis is independently verified; it is not a timestamp conversion or classification proof.

raw_fields.time: UTC epoch seconds as documented for obtained tick data
raw_fields.time_msc: millisecond field returned in the same documented tick structure; precision is represented, but separate precision wording was not found

timestamp_basis_disposition.statement: Official MetaQuotes documentation establishes UTC for data obtained through copy_ticks_range; it does not establish WM Markets session rules or historical broker schedule facts.
